entries.name: Amazon Web Services
entries.does: Hosts the tool: the relay, the job ledger, saved projects, the library and every uploaded or generated file.
entries.receives: Everything the tool keeps for the agency.

region.source: infra/envs/hackathon, the region of every resource

entries.name: Runway
entries.does: Generates pictures and video. Every model the tool runs is reached through Runway's API.
entries.receives: The words, reference pictures, frames and clips a job sends.

entries.name: Google
entries.does: Makes the Gemini picture models and the Veo video models.
entries.receives: What a job sends to a Gemini or Veo model.

entries.name: Ideogram
entries.receives: What a job sends to an Ideogram model.

entries.name: Magnific
entries.receives: The picture or clip a job upscales.

entries.name: Anthropic (Claude on Amazon Bedrock)
entries.does: Directs each job and reads reference pictures for the director.
entries.receives: The words, the script and the reference pictures of a job.

region.source: production-tool/relay/director/claude.py, whose model ids start eu.
